facts.text: Andrew enjoys hiking as an outdoor activity that refreshes him and provides a sense of accomplishment.

evidence.quote: Well for me hiking is the best. Being out in nature with all the trees and fresh air always refreshes me. Reaching the top of a challenging trail is amazing too - it feels like all worries just vanish when you get to the top.

facts.text: Andrew finds being in nature to be a calming experience that helps him relax and escape from city life.

evidence.quote: Yeah, nature really calms me down and relaxes my mind. It's like a break from the craziness of city living.

facts.text: Audrey agrees with Andrew that nature provides a sense of accomplishment and helps to alleviate worries.

evidence.quote: Yeah, totally. It's like you've achieved something and all worries just fade away. Nature is pretty special, huh?

facts.text: Audrey mentions that her pets have been a source of comfort and happiness during difficult times.

evidence.quote: My pets have been my good ol' buddies during all the tough times! They make me so happy and I love them so much.
